# Deliverables
- A clear understanding of the login process and requirements.
- Implementation of the login functionality using the specified technologies.
- Documentation of the code and any necessary setup instructions.
# Context
- The login process will utilize Azure AD for authentication.
- For the moment we will bypass the login and auth process for development purposes.
- The login page should look modern and be styled according to the application's design system.
- The login page should contain the following elements:
  - A header with the application logo and name.
  - A form with fields for email and password.
  - A "Login" button.
  - Links to "Forgot Password?" and "Sign Up" pages.
  - and a microsoft login button for msal authentication.

# Quality

- Ensure proper folder structure is maintained when implementing the login functionality.
- Follow best practices for code organization, including separation of concerns and modular design.
- Write unit tests for critical components and functions to ensure reliability and maintainability.
